notes.title: Playtest Ended
notes.notes:
I want to thank those that took part in the test.

A lot of feedback has been gathered and noted.

What is clear from the test,

1. The game loop needs more to it.
2. UI and ship UI controls need a rework
3. its not really clear on how to do things. like landing and cargo runs etc
4. alot of work on the flight mechanics.

There is alot more but these come to mind as I write this.
Its clear the game needs to head in a better direction. but also there was alot of positive feedback to.

So stay tuned to the discord or forums for further updates.

Again. Thank you for those that took part.

notes.title: Play Test Is Now Live
notes.notes:
Hi all,
I'm pleased to announce that a new Round of play testing has begun.
This is free to try so please go ahead and try the game out.

As always this is an EARLY version of the game and as such features and bugs are still being worked on.
if you haven't already. join the discord and help build the game.

many thanks 
Richard
Developer

notes.title: Play Test has come To An End
notes.notes:
Hi all.
The play test has come to an end for now. I want to thank everyone who tried the game and gave feedback.
Moving forward, I will be working on progression and other features as well as fixing changing some of your feedback you gave.

Once I feel there is enough new content to test I shall resume the playtest once again.

Again thank you, don't forget to join the discord and Patreon to keep up with updates and progress.

Thanks
Richard
